filter.formula: WinProb_i = 0.0 if gambit_flag_i_t == 1 else exp(mu_i) / sum_{j not gambit} exp(mu_j)
filter.note: Frozen math (PLAN.md). gambit_flag_i_t = 1 iff week t is in that housemate's gambit_periods weeks. Gambit housemates keep their finale slot: p_rank_1 == 0 but p_top3/p_top5 and runner-up podium eligibility remain live.

notes: Week-1 public vote (Flora 29.18%, Aikou 9.10%) elected The Gambit: immunity from week-1 eviction + automatic finale slot + ineligible for the grand prize. Release event returned both to prize eligibility from week 6. Backfilled weeks 1-5 standings must apply the filter to Flora/Aikou; weeks 6+ apply to nobody. Sources: docs/season-recon.md.
